seo.title: Organic Cotton Tampons & Pads — GOTS Certified | Lore Organics
seo.description: Premium organic period care for the Netherlands and Germany. GOTS certified organic cotton tampons, plastic free pads and biodegradable liners. Biologische tampons, biologisch maandverband en Bio Binden, launching October 2026.

hero.body: Organic cotton period care, because your vagina matters. Made in Europe. Tested by yours truly.
hero.imageAlt: Lore Organics pad and tampon boxes standing in soft leaf-shadow daylight

boxCard.title: Build your Cycle Box
boxCard.body: Mix pads and tampons by flow. Save up to 10%, skip or pause anytime.

firstPeriod.lead: While you've been changing and evolving into the woman you are today, the pad from your very first period probably hasn't.
lines: GOTS-certified organic cotton. Made in Europe. Dermatologically and gynecologically tested.
But like all humans, we're not perfect. Yet.

materials.title: Materials
materials.body: Pads and liners: a GOTS-certified organic cotton topsheet and core, with a plant-based backing. Tampons: GOTS-certified organic cotton. Fragrance free. Made in Europe. Every material is listed on each product page.

testing.title: Testing
testing.body: Our pads and tampons are dermatologically tested and gynecologically tested. Because your period is enough to deal with already.

certification.title: Certification
certification.body: Our cotton is GOTS certified. The Global Organic Textile Standard covers how it's grown and processed, including fair wages, safe working conditions and no child labor. Because all people are created equal, but not all pads are.

founders.label: Our founders
founders.body: Rachael and Geneviève met nine years ago in Paris and have been on the other end of the line for each other ever since. Lore is what they built together.
founders.imageAlt: Rachael Hoogkamer and Geneviève Silvestra, founders of Lore Organics, walking together

lore.heading: The Lore of LORE.
lore.subline: Period lore, rewritten. One short episode at a time.

giving.title: From one woman to another.
giving.body: We donate 1% of everything we sell, as product, to Armoedefonds, who get it to women in the Netherlands who can't afford period care.
